in_hebrew.name: Rusty
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Reddish or rough
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Rusty הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word 'rūstan', meaning 'reddish' or 'rustic'. This name has come to be used as a nickname or term of endearment, often for someone with a reddish complexion or a rustic, down-to-earth personality.
